purpose: Original synthetic cross-check: Python placement/fit findings and the TypeScript section layout must agree. Not physical qualification.

cases.name: double-placed shielded two-core
cases.why: Linear pitch plus manual offsets place both cores twice as far out; the drain cuts into the screen.

findings.message: stock.pair.c1 extends 0.700 mm beyond the bore of stock.screen.
stock.pair.c2 extends 0.700 mm beyond the bore of stock.screen.
stock.drain extends 0.350 mm beyond the bore of stock.screen.
stock.pair.c1 extends 0.350 mm beyond the bore of stock.jacket.
stock.pair.c2 extends 0.350 mm beyond the bore of stock.jacket.
stock.pair.c1 has a manual offset added to its arranged position in stock.pair; arranged members are placed by pitch, so offsets move them twice.
stock.pair.c2 has a manual offset added to its arranged position in stock.pair; arranged members are placed by pitch, so offsets move them twice.

cases.name: laid-up shielded two-core
cases.why: The same construction laid up by pitch only, with the drain in the upper interstice.

cases.name: three-core ring counterclockwise
cases.why: Ring members start at 12 o'clock; a central filler fills the space between them.

cases.name: three-core ring clockwise and too small
cases.why: Clockwise order; ring pitch smaller than touching so neighboring cores overlap.

findings.message: stock.cores.c1 and stock.cores.c2 overlap by 0.261 mm.
stock.cores.c1 and stock.cores.c3 overlap by 0.261 mm.
stock.cores.c2 and stock.cores.c3 overlap by 0.261 mm.

cases.name: unknown pitch and unknown bore
cases.why: Unknown ring pitch leaves member positions unknown; an unknown jacket bore is not evaluated.

cases.name: unknown drain offset
cases.why: A drain whose interstice position is not yet known keeps a null offset: position unknown, never the center.
